name: 3D Weld Lab
_comment: ONE road entity, ONE welder (buildRoadNetMesh): an east-west road at grade at its ends (welding into two cross streets at nodes 1 and 8), rising on ramps to a +9 m elevated deck, FLYING OVER a north-south surface street (edge [14,15]) with a clean underpass, and descending again. node_elev authors the deck height; the unified welder builds the ramps, the elevated deck, the piers, AND grade-separates the deck from the street it crosses (weld-or-cross by Δz) — the SAME welder that builds the flat streets, no separate corridor/bridge mesher. Proof-in-code that the road graph is 3D: ramps mesh with the ground streets, and a deck flies over a live road without merging into it.
